The second named those and forbade the terraces and still came back flat: standard mode draws a texture, and a dendritic gully network is geometry. Four more were run side by side and compared as autotiled patches over grass (`var/scratch/loess-cand.mts`): harder shading gave a fainter hatch on the same flat ground, `badlands` gave a regular diagonal corduroy that reads as weaving, `large simple landforms` gave a blank cream shelf, and pro mode with `raggedness` 0.55 drew the branching tree outright.
